config.ffmpegPath.description: Path to the ffmpeg executable (defaults to system PATH)
config.deleteOriginal.description: Delete the original file after successful compression
config.outputSuffix.description: Suffix appended to compressed single files (e.g. "-compressed" → image-compressed.png, "@1x" → image@1x.png). Has no effect when multiple files are selected.
config.useOxipng.description: Use oxipng as a second-stage lossless PNG optimizer (TinyPNG-level results). Disable if you don't want to install oxipng — PNG will still be compressed by pngquant but the output will be 10–20% larger.
config.title: Media Compressor
